nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Super Multi-Corrective Eye Zone Treatment

avis.texte: I have very puffy eye lids and this helps so so much. Worth it 100%

I've been using this eye cream for about a week and have noticed the area around my eyes becoming more sensitive. It hurts/burns to wash my face with my gentle face wash. I do like the feel and smell of this product, it does help fine lines so far.
Usually love Kiehls but this eye cream smells really odd. I will not purchase again.

Though I haven't been using this long enough to have seen improvements per se, I will say that this eye cream has helped maintain the condition of my eye area. Gel cream texture, non irritating. Nice!

I have used orher Kiehls products and loved them so I had high hopes for this eye cream. Unfortunately the odor is so off-putting that I'm dissuaded from using it. No wonder it was on BOGO. I've tried and I just can't get past the stink.

avis.titre: Beware if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: Here's an edited version of your review: --- I have sensitive skin, and this product made the skin under my eyes start burning almost immediately. I quickly wiped most of the product off, but I woke up to very swollen, red, and itchy under eyes and eyelids.

I tried the avocado one and sent it back. It was too watery. This cream is lux and that's what I was looking for. I use it morning and night. Makeup goes well over it which is a plus. My under eyes are so much more hydrated now!
I noticed in a couple of weeks a nice change in the skin around my eyes
This product works so well for dark circles . I am using way less concealer since I've started using this! At night for extra hydration I Use the avocado eye cream .
I noticed a difference immediately and can't wait to see how much it will help over time.
This cream burned my eye on the first time I used it…. Woke up with a red burn under my right eye in the morning.

I used to have noticeable crows feet but after using this product for about 3 months, it's less pronounced now. After noticing a difference, I also applied it to my entire face and my skin looks great.

I was excited to have a product that does all 4 things in one, but I don't really like the gel-like texture and putrid color. I prefer the nice soft bright white cream of the Powerful Wrinkle Reducing Eye Cream (copper jar). I also don't like that this is slightly scented, which seems to be an unfortunate trend with the Super Multi-Corrective line. The entire jar only lasted me 6 weeks, whereas the Powerful lasts me several months. I think less comes in the container, as others have noted.
i love that there is no smell to this, the texture is so silky smooth and you honestly dont need much.
When I tell you that this product works wonders, believe me! I've noticed the texture of my face has changed to the better!
After using the face and neck cream, I decided to try the eye cream. It did not disappoint. I love it. I actually mix it with my under eye cover so it doesn't sink into wrinkles. Love it.

I use this moisturizer every morning and it works great for anti-aging. I notice a big difference in my forehead lines. When I use this consistently my forehead lines disappear! I get compliments on my skin regularly and I always tell people it's Kiehl's!
Saw the reviews and decided to try this eye cream. Was totally disappointed because it doesn't absorb at all and stays on skin as a thick layer.

I adopted a mix of 6 products two weeks ago to do daily/nightly as a skin care routine, and so far everyone I work with has said how much younger, healthier and glowy my skin looks. Love this! Love finally having a beneficial results driven skincare routine!
Best eye cream I've used and found to date. I love the texture of it and that you can use it for upper eyelids as well.

I enjoy using this cream as a part of my skincare routine. I haven't yet realized changes since it's a recent purchase, but it has no smell and leaves the applied area refreshed and happy after the application.
Lightweight lotion that smooths out lines and wrinkles all day. A little goes a long way, so it is a good value. I let it dry a little before applying moisturizer and make-up for best results.
Just bought this for the first time, I really like it! I've seen a definite small difference in fine lines, love the texture of this as well.

i had a sample of this product to try before buying the full product. i used this one evening after my shower and woke up the next morning and my mole under my eye was red, swollen, painful, and filled with pus. Ive never had a reaction to my mole before with any eye cream / skin care. I was afraid and stopped use. After the mole drained its back to normal but im sad this product gave me such a reaction.

avis.titre: I miss the pump dispenser for this.
avis.texte: Bring back the pump. In this form, the cream is too thick and does not go smoothly on the eye area without a lot of rubbing in. The pump had a lighter, smoother consistency.
Got a sample of this product I liked. When I ordered it, I found after it dries, it rubs off in rubbery shards that get into my eyes -- and are visible around my eyes.
This is the best eye cream I've ever used. I love the lightweight feel and it absorbs into my skin easily. I would definitely recommend this product to my friends. Love, love, love it!
Goes on easily and is quickly absorbed. Too soon to see a difference, but it's hypoallergenic, which is what I need.

avis.titre: Stopped using it after a couple days
avis.texte: My wife is getting some reactions (milia seeds) after using this.

avis.titre: Causing dry patches, itching and puffy under eyes
avis.texte: I love kiehls products. Sadly this is a hard no for me. I started using it and then I would wake up the next morning with puffy undereyes, itchiness and dry patches. I stopped using for a while to see if this was the cause, I used it again a couple weeks later and the same thing happened. and I'm not sensitive to skincare products at all. This wasn't cheap either. Very disappointing.
I have loved this eye cream, but this batch smells like fish. It's awful, can't use it.
My skin feels soft and supple after using this cream. I simply never want to be without it!

I was using the powerful wrinkle reducing cream with copper PCA and had better results with that product than this one. The previous formula seems to be discontinued and replaced with this one, so that is disappointing.

I love kiehls products. Sadly this was is a hard no for me. I started using it and then I would wake up the next morning with puffy undereyes, itchy ness and dry patches. I stopped using for a while to see if this was the cause, I used it again a couple weeks later and the same thing happened. and I'm not sensitive to skincare products at all. This wasn't cheap either. Very disappointing.

avis.titre: Not worth the price in my opinion.
avis.texte: This is a good, but not especially great, eye cream. It is extremely pricey in comparison to the results.

avis.titre: Don't buy online. Buy in store and check product.
avis.texte: Product arrived and the container was only about 60% full. Not happy at all. I will not be buying items online ever again as this is second time this has happened. There is lack of quality control. Consider buying at the store and checking the product first.

avis.titre: Love the Multi-Corrective Anti-Aging Eye Cream!
avis.texte: This product has made a big difference to my eyelids and under the eyes - eyelids much smoother, undereye bags less noticeable, dark circles improved. I use it day and night and will continue to use it daily!

avis.titre: Potentially a great eye firming produce
avis.texte: So far so good. Not super concentrated, though it may be doing the job. It's still early to say. I do enjoy the texture and weight.

avis.titre: Leaves face moisturized without greasy feeling
avis.texte: I love this product! A little goes a long way! Feels amazing on my face, neck and décolleté! Non-greasy or oily feeling! It's the perfect nighttime treatment and my face feels moisturized and refreshed in the morning on my very dry skin!

avis.titre: Nice cream but jar is half empty
avis.texte: The order was easy and delivery was fast. The cream has a nice texture and feels cooling. The only downside is that the jar came only a bit over 1/2 full. I wonder if this is standard or if I got a previously opened cream. There was no seal on it.

I really didn't expect to see a difference when I started using this cream. Wow! Was I wrong. I just look less tired. It is as simple as that. Wonderful. It doesn't get in my eyes and make them goopy either.

avis.titre: Make sure you get the soft cream!
avis.texte: Great new texture with the soft cream - I would advise anyone with combo skin - sensitive etc… to use the soft cream - this was the only product that made me break out - the I switched and it was like night and day - use it with the wrinkle eye cream - and you can use anytime - it's great for the winter! I like to use at night and use my age defender during the day. Both are phenomenal ( for me )
It was not properly protected during shipping and package was damaged.

While the lotion was smooth and silky, it caused the skin around my eyes to become red and small white granules started to pop up around my eyes. I used it for about one week and then had to stop. The day after I stopped using it the white granules went away. The redness is still there and I'm hoping it t goes away soon
Overpriced crap. Bad custpmer service. Lost my business forever
Refreshing eye cream! Helpls calm and sooth the areas around my eyes and adds needed moisture.
I can't believe the results. Got it because recently I got a very deep wrinkle on my eyes... And a few weeks after is almost invisible.
Had a sample that I really liked but the one I ordered has a weird smell and weird texture. Maybe I got a bad one but I don't like it.
Extremely oily and not good for my pores. Used at night and left film
Loved it! It's rich and moisturizes well. Been using it for a long time.

Like other Kiehl's face care products that I use, this eye cream covers lines and puffiness around the eyes, without feeling heavy or greasy. It is quickly absorbed into the skin and does not irritate. I rely on Kiehl's to make my skin look and feel it's best, under all circumstances. The skin products never disappoint.
I love this eye cream, glides on easily without having to use a lot of it and dries fairly fast!
Have used other eye creams, including ones from Kiehls but this one is the best

avis.titre: Fabulously light, refreshing and great results
avis.texte: As the years catch up to us all, I realized that I needed an anti-aging eye cream. The Super Multi-Corrective Anti-Aging Eye Cream is silky, absorbs quickly and feels wonderfully refreshing. I noticed an improvement within a few days and now never go to bed without applying it. Best of all, it has no scent which is important when you're applying a product around the sensitive eye area.

I just got this yesterday, so I don't have much to say about it yet except that it is very thick and creamy and I like that. The problem that I have is that the container is only half full. I know what can occur during shipping, but I tried settling the contents. It still looks like 1/3 of the product is missing. I would rather have a smaller container that produces less waste than feel cheated because 1/3 of the product looks like it's missing.
I think I might have purchased the wrong moisturizer as my skin is dry and I am old. I need to use it a little longer to know if it is right for me

avis.titre: Shockingly small amount in a large jar
avis.texte: Shockingly small amount of product in a large jar. Could even see the bottom on one side. I understand some settling after packaging but I'd generously say this was 1/2 full. The product itself seems pretty nice though, but very much not worth the price.

After trying numerous eye creams to combat severe dry skin (and prevent aging signs), this cream is awesome (even better than the ones the derms recommended). It's light, yet creamy. It absorbs fast and the skin around the eyes definitely looks more fresh.
Received a jas like this. I can almost see the bottom on one side.

I have been using this eye cream for years but this last order I received caused my eyes to water excessively, so much that I got evaluated for blocked tear ducts. I stopped using the eye cream, the issue seemed to resolve after a couple of weeks so I started using again and my eyes went right back to tearing excessively!
I usually use the Vitamin C Eye serum but I had a sample of the SMCAAEC in my travel case. I love how smoothing it is and how the lines under my eyes are reduced.

Very nice eye cream, especially since it can be used on all areas of the eye. This is my 2nd purchase but I'm still speechless that the jar was HALF EMPTY! For the money I paid, I'm truly sorely disappointed by Kiehl's. I've been a loyal fan for 40 years and this was incredibly disappointing.

avis.titre: Collagen cannot be uptaken by the skin
avis.texte: The thing is that collagen is a huge molecule and it cannot be uptaken by the skin. It will just sit on top of the dermis and is doing nothing. This needs better costumer education.
Eye cream is hydrating and lightens dark spots. My skin is brighter and younger looking.

Very tacky and hard to spread / dab under the eye. Not a fan. The last thing I wanna do is stretch the skin back and forth under my eyes...I'm 52 and trying not to manipulate my already sensitive skin :). Not able to wear any makeup over the eye cream -- it stays sticky for way too long.

Love this eye cream. Helps with wrinkles, loose skin around eyes. I have very dry eyes and it moisturizers the skin around my eyes, it feels heavenly. I've use many other brands and Kiehl's's is my favorite. I am 67 years old.

avis.titre: An eye cream that refreshes my eyes overnight.
avis.texte: Easy to use. Smooth without being greasy. Almost refreshing!
love the eye cream, cooling, smooth and my eyes look fab. i recommend this!

I started using this over a year ago and I love it. My issues are more my eyelids and this seems to help them better. It's light and my eyes are not irritated by using it. Overall, I feel the area around my eyes look better, younger, and less tired.

avis.titre: Doesn't compare to the powerful wrinkle cream
avis.texte: Kiehl's should have stayed with their "Powerful Wrinkle Reducing Cream" as it was much much better

This eye cream is thick and creamy, but not greasy. I love the texture and how smoothly it goes on my undereye area and upper eyelid. It doesn't sting or burn my eyes, which has been a problem with some eye creams I have used. My eye area is left nicely hydrated. I do plan on buying this luxurious eye cream again.
On my second month of using and it seems to be doing something. I'm a 44yo male with no noticeable signs of aging around my eyes but I'm in it for the long run and will continue using this daily.
I've been looking for an eye cream like this one with such creamy texture. I use it on my upper and lower eyelids daily.
The lack of clear instructions on use and what to expect keeps this and all Khiel's products from getting a 5* rating... The cream seems to make my eyes fatigue after a full day...
This product works great in cooler climates. A lot of oily residue after use due to humid temperatures. I don't recommend using it in humid climates such as Florida.

I have used this product for awhile now and loved it hence the order from the website itself. This one in particular is thicker in consistency that is somewhat harder to apply evenly. Most of all it's smells like rust or fish. The previous jars I had had a more subtle pleasant smell and not as thick. The fish smell is nauseating and lingers until the next day, even sticks to the head pillow.

I've been using it for a month,and I don't see any change in the appearance of wrinkles in the under eye area. It's at best a decent moisturizer, but not sure you would want to pay that high of a price.

I used an entire pot of this product last year with no issues. Bought another pot and discontinued using bc I thought I was having seasonal allergy symptoms (puffy eyes, watering, etc.). Decided to try it again last night and my eyes have been steadily swelling up all day long. Reading thru the reviews, it seems this is a fairly regular occurrence. Has Kiehl's reformulated this product? I seriously hope this clears up in the next day or so...
Works very well and people will notice a difference on your face in a week or maybe sooner.
When I got the package. I saw it like this. Idk what's going on?
This is my favorite eye cream. The texture is silky and my eyes feel and look tighter
I love it and have already seen results, especially less puffiness!
Wanted to like eye serum but my eyes had a reaction. Customer service was very helpful, I've never had a problem with Kiehls before

I've been using this night cream for about 2 years now since a previous night cream was discontinued, and I really like it. I am 75 and people really compliment the looks of my skin and that I don't look my age. Of course a good skin-care routine is part of it, and as we age, we need to adjust what works. This works!
My eyes are very sensitive and your cream does not irritate the skin around my eyes. I am disappointed, however, that it is not longer offered in a sealed pump container
Nasty fishy odor …not at all like the sample I got from the store.
Hasn't shown any improvement for my eyes after using for over 30 days

As a 50+ marketing pro, I have had the opportunity to try, literally, some of the best eye creams on the market - from the most expensive brands to drugstore lines. Many have been very good. But this one is INCREDIBLE. It checks every box as described. The depuffing effects alone are quite impressive. This eye cream does what it's advertised to do with no added fragrance of any type which is important for the eye area. Highly recommend

I've used this product for some time. Unfortunately, the last two jars both had an extremely foul and unpleasant odor. Not sure if there was a formula change (?)…Prior to this I was pleased with the product.
When I first started using the eye cream, my eyelids were itchy. After a few days , my eyes were burning, itchy, and they swelled up. Had to go to the eye doctor.

avis.titre: I couldn't get passed the smell
avis.texte: I received a sample and loved the sample. When I purchased the actual product, I noticed a really bad smell. I'm not sure if I received a bad batch, but I had to return it. It was not a pleasant smell.

Sorry if this is a repeat.....I don't think my 1st try went thru. I feel bad giving a low review, but since I received this in my last order I have had undereye swelling (in addition to my puffiness) and tearing each time I have used it. I stop for a few days and then try again with the same results. I have used many other of your products, including the avocado under eye product, without any negative results.
I used this product for 3 months, every day and every night. I took before and after pictures and there was no change on my eyes or eye lids at all. I was so disappointed because I was so hopeful!
This product had a bad odor that caused me to become ill, and has made this product unusable for me.

avis.titre: Softens my fine lines and wrinkles
avis.texte: I am using the anti- aging eye cream only at night. The skin around my eyes has fine lines and wrinkles, not too deep. This eye cream has made improvements on the lines and wrinkles by softening them even more.
This smells like mashed banana. It made my eye area puffy, so this wasn't for me.

avis.titre: Burns eye area & lids - be cautious! Disappointed
avis.texte: I really tried to give this product a chance. 5+ weeks before I decided to review. Being a women in my early 30s I wanted to start using something regularly. I tried using twice a day. Morning and night. At first my eyes were a little irritated. I just thought it was bc of allergy season and kept using it. But I noticed it burns my eyes, irritates and burns my skin underneath my eyes and my eye lids. It doesn't start irritating my skin/eyes until about 3-5 minutes after use. I tried using the tiniest amount To see if that helped and then to only once a day, it didn't. I tried using 15 mins after washing my face to see if that helped, it hasn't. I actually ended up going to the eye doctor bc I didn't realize it was from this product. Confirmed I was not allergic to the product but confirmed the cream was causing the irritation. Disappointed bc this product has great reviews. And it's a very steep price for .5ml

avis.titre: Just a great all-around facial cream
avis.texte: Love how light this cream is and not greasy. Notice immediately I look awake and wrinkles are less noticeavke
Burning eyelids, eyes swollen & red this morning. Had to use icepacks to help the swelling

avis.titre: Found the eye cream I'll use the rest of my life!
avis.texte: I have been looking for this cream for at least a decade. Didn't know it would be Kiehl (needed my daughter to recommend the brand) but this is the BEST eye cream I've ever had. It addresses under-eye wrinkles perfectly and I don't even have to use it every day (but I usually do). It doesn't hurt my eyes but the active ingredient is perfect for gently plumping my eye area such that the wrinkles are basically gone. I will use this cream the rest of my life and I thank my daughter so much for leading me to Kiehl and this eye cream.
I received this as a sample when I ordered other products. The first time I used it I noticed a great improvement in the appearance of my face. I will be using it in the future.
It's only been six weeks, but I have not noticed a difference. The texture of the item is very soft and smooth, but I do not see anything changing in my face or on my eyes.

avis.titre: Burning Eyelids, Swollen Shut and now Flaking
avis.texte: My eyelids and under my eyes became flakey, dry and burned/itched. I wasn't sure it was the eye cream, so I stopped using it for over a month and allowed my skin to heal. On Thursday, I tried the eye cream again. By evening, my eyelids burned horribly. When I woke on Friday, my left eyelid was swollen shut and my right eyelid was puffy. I had to ice my eyes, and it affected my vision so badly that I couldn't drive all day. It's now Saturday, and my eyelids started flaking, they burn uncomfortably, and they are still puffy. This stuff was poison to my face! I will never buy it again, and honestly don't know if I should ever use kiehls again. I doubt I can get refunded.
Great product! I'm 47, and people ask me all the time what I use because I have very few lines around my eyes.
I used to love this product but they must have changed the ingredients. I put in on last night from a new supply and in the morning I woke up with both my eyes were swollen.
This does what it says; however, leaves my eye area a little dry.

This eye cream is moisturizing and is slowly but surely brightening and lifting the skin in my eye area---and I don't even use it 2xs/day. I can only imagine the results I'd see if I used it morning and night. I first purchased the small jar. Once it ran out, I purchased the larger jar. I'm so pleased with the results of this eye cream that I want to continue using it even longer to see whether I get even better results. Also, I'm a contact lens wearer. This eye cram has not interfered with my contact lenses. I've also worn this eye cream under make-up without any problems.

avis.titre: Amazing product that is worth the money
avis.texte: Great product, delivers everything it says. I had issues with puffy eyes and dropping lid lids and within a month.

Love this line. Love the face cream, so I ordered this. It comes in the typical tiny jar for eye creams, but it's half full, and for the premium on the price tag, it should at least be full. Quite disappointed, although the product itself is great.
Effective and easy to apply. Not greasy at all. You can see a difference after 2weeks of constant usage as directed.

I use it every am & pm. Doesn't irritate eyes or skin. I have noticed a difference in skin texture, smoothness & refreshed. I recommend this to everyone. Alittle goes a Long way. Skin Care is a Must 🌺
There was a quality control issue with filling of the containers. The container I received was only 1/2 full of eye cream.
I was disappointed in this product. It feels great as soon as I put it on, but after about 10 minutes my skin is burning.
